purpose: Ground-truth inventory of every AOP data source. Open website/data_sources.html to browse it.

layers_of_reality.db: PostGIS store of record — the converged, normalized spine.
layers_of_reality.served: Files website/ loads — classified by origin (core-backed / raw-pipeline / sidecar / runtime-buffer).

tables.note: The ONE converged geo table — CMFS spine + JSONB attrs, one row shape for every layer.
The WHEN — one row per event occurrence/session.
The reusable WHAT — place-agnostic activities, no geometry.
The umbrella EVENT metadata — the WHO/WHEN banner.
The source register — where every claim comes from.
